## Specialist and priority
Lead: TECH / GAMEPLAY / WORLD / ANIMATION / UX / QA
Priority: P0 / P1 / P2

## Problem and evidence
Observed behaviour, linked logs/screenshots, affected commit and affected players. Do not invent failures.

## Intended result
Describe what should change. Link Game Director approval for new gameplay/design choices.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Measurable behavioural criteria
- [ ] Unit/browser/device verification appropriate to this issue
- [ ] Existing saves and key game systems preserved
- [ ] Independent QA/cross-role review

## Scope limits and dependencies
Files likely affected; other open PRs; what is expressly out of scope.

## Handoff
Branch: `ai/<role>/<issue>-topic`, starting from latest `dev`.
PR: link when opened.
Test evidence: link once executed.
Deployment: dev only after signoff; public untouched.
